hero.title: Independent Cryptographic Verification for Bangladesh Land Records
hero.subtitle: Stop land disputes and double-selling before closing. Powered by Ed25519 digital signatures, immutable SHA-256 hash chains, and explainable AI fraud detection.
hero.cta_check_desc: Inspect plot risk score, ownership chain, and legal flags by Mouza & Dag number

hero.pillar1_desc: Every deed is digitally signed with the Sub-Registrar's secret key. Any alteration breaks the mathematical proof in milliseconds.
hero.pillar2_desc: Per-plot SHA-256 blockchain-style chaining prevents retroactive deletion, reordering, or covert insertion of history.
hero.pillar3_desc: Pre-registration blocks double sales, impossible overselling, stranger sellers, and unregistered transfers automatically.

admin.title: LandShield System Administration
admin.subtitle: Tamper Lab cryptographic forgery demonstration & immutable system audit log
admin.tamper_desc: Demonstrate the mathematical guarantees of Ed25519 signatures and SHA-256 hash chains. Modifying a single character or number in the database payload without re-signing mathematically invalidates the deed immediately.
admin.demo_disabled_msg: Tamper Lab is disabled in production mode (DEMO_MODE=false).
admin.tamper_confirm: Simulate Forgery: This will alter the deed payload area sold in the database by +1.0 decimal without updating the cryptographic signature. Are you sure?
admin.restore_confirm: Restore Deed: This will restore the authentic deed payload from the tamper backup. Proceed?
admin.tamper_success: Deed payload altered! Verification will now detect HASH_MISMATCH.
admin.restore_success: Deed payload restored to authentic state.
admin.audit_desc: Chronological, immutable audit records tracking all administrative, registrar, and officer operations.
